title: Supplemental follow-up demo for the Evolve QT demo
summary: The demo covers Braille input on the Evolve QT using NVDA's PC Keyboard Braille Input add-on, how to bring up the drive list in Keysoft File Manager (Control+D), and how to access Keysoft application shortcuts to simplify ribbon use in Microsoft Office apps (Alt → down Arrow → Enter).
body:
The demo covers Braille input on the Evolve QT using NVDA's PC Keyboard Braille Input add-on, how to bring up the drive list in Keysoft File Manager (Control+D), and how to access Keysoft application shortcuts to simplify ribbon use in Microsoft Office apps (Alt → down Arrow → Enter).
